title: Default temp-targets won't set from watch
body:
When trying to set a predefined temp-target (ex. Eating Soon) from the new temp target tile I get an error:
![Watch_Screenshot_220404-153731](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/93551840/161548761-be8ea6e7-bc91-4d90-aeb4-7965b8a544d5.jpeg)
Setting manual temp-target from watch works OK.
**Using dev version on wear only, 3.0.0.1 master on phone. Great tiles feature in general, thanks a lot!

comments.body: i believe this is already fixed in dev. can you test it?
Generated updated apk one hour ago, still having this issue...
Do you have the same versions on AAPS and watch (built from the same dev version )?
No. As I said I use dev on watch only...
Might explain the bug. Can you try dev on both ? I can set TT from tiles on my watch.
I would like to do so, but since I use aaps for daily use, stability is very important for me on phone...

Probably fixed in one of the devs. Dev-F on watch and Dev-I on phone. Set _Activity_ from the watch tiles and phone set a TT of 150. It is now working.

I think you can close this issue.
